g.text: 1. UNLESS SPECIFIED: DIMS IN mm. LINEAR TOL: ±0.20 mm.
2. MANUFACTURING: FDM 3D PRINTING (0.20 mm LAYER HEIGHT).
3. THREADED INSERTS: M3 / M4 BRASS HEAT-SET (220°C PRESS).
4. ELECTRICAL: 12V DC SELV OPERATION (CLASS II ISOLATION).
5. Features rear fan shelf, front clevis, and 5 convective louvers.
